source.basis: Operator spec page; structured facts only, no operator prose reproduced.

reading.body:
CyrusOne's San Antonio campus publishes 36 MW of IT capacity across 295,785 square feet, making it the fourth largest campus in Texas by disclosed megawatts.

The published figure is a single campus total, not a per-building breakdown. No rack count and no tenant are named. Converting 36 MW to racks requires assuming a density the operator does not publish, so any rack estimate is arithmetic on an outside assumption rather than a CyrusOne claim.

The certifications cover payment card data, health information, information security management, federal systems, financial reporting controls, and telecommunications design. They qualify the campus for categories of workload. They do not identify who occupies the buildings.

Texas has 137 mapped facilities, but only 19 publish a power figure, and those 19 total 475.41 MW. The fourth-place ranking therefore rests on a small disclosed subset. Most of the state's mapped capacity is invisible to this comparison, and 36 MW is a meaningful share of what Texas has actually disclosed.

suitability.basis: weighted mean of the published inputs named here, scaled to 100; formula on the methodology page
